card.name: Rounding to available dose strengths
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions about rounding a calculated dose to what a product can actually deliver, such as available tablet strength or closest dose achievable with prefilled syringes. It fires on the linking word just before 'strength', 'sizes' or 'multiples'.

modes.label: Closest achievable dose
modes.description: Words in phrases about rounding to the dose a syringe or device can deliver.
modes.example: Increase dose by approximately 50% to the closest dose achievable with<< the>> prefilled syringes Hb increases

modes.label: Available strengths
modes.description: Words in phrases about using tablet or solution strengths that are on the market.
modes.example: Round down, if necessary, to the appropriate Methadone Hydrochloride Oral<< Solution>> strengths available.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward 'sizes', 'multiples', 'increments' and 'fixed', as in fixed dose steps.
card.plain: It marks places where the label says to round a dose to the fixed strengths or steps a product comes in.
